item.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's third-country deportations
item.description: The Supreme Court will let the Trump administration's policy to deport immigrants to third countries continue and will review the legal question.

item.title: Trump uses Supreme Court shadow docket more than three predecessors combined
item.description: The Trump administration filed its 41st application to the Supreme Court's shadow docket on Monday, matching the total of previous administrations.

item.title: Artist JMSN objects to Trump using his song
item.description: Artist JMSN is demanding the Trump administration stop using his song "Love Me," which served as background music for a controversial government ad.

item.title: OpenAI faces landmark lawsuit after Hugging Face hack
item.description: A public interest law group sued OpenAI on Tuesday over its breach of Hugging Face, seeking court-ordered restrictions.
